items.title: Science Lab Wheelchair-Accessible Station & Lowered Bench
items.content_html: Retrofit Station #1 in Chemistry Lab B with an adjustable-height ADA workbench, accessible sink controls, and clear knee clearance.

_polytab.summary: Retrofit Station #1 in Chemistry Lab B with an adjustable-height ADA workbench, accessible sink controls, and clear knee clearance.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Chemistry lab tables are too high for wheelchair users.
What will be done: Install a height-adjustable lab desk.
Proof: Photo of installed desk co-signed by student accessibility council.

items.title: North Stadium Bleacher Power-Wash & Handrail Repaint

_polytab.summary: Clear debris under visitor bleachers, pressure-wash aluminum benches, and apply rust-oleate safety yellow paint to stair handrails.
_polytab.plainSummary:

items.title: East Entrance Tactile Paving & Curb-Cut Repair
items.content_html: Patch cracked concrete lip on the East sidewalk ramp and install high-visibility truncated dome tactile mats for blind and low-vision navigation.

_polytab.summary: Patch cracked concrete lip on the East sidewalk ramp and install high-visibility truncated dome tactile mats for blind and low-vision navigation.
_polytab.plainSummary:
What is broken: Cracked sidewalk ramp blocks wheelchairs and lacks textured bumps for cane users.
What will be done: Smooth concrete lip and bolt down yellow tactile dome mat.
Proof: Geo-tagged video test.

items.title: Art Studio Sink Trap Cleanout & Brush Restock
